title: How do we draw five angles with a protractor?
description: Five angles of different sizes are drawn with a protractor. For each one, the centre goes on the vertex, the base ray lies on a zero line, and the degrees are counted from that zero up to the size needed.
teaching_notes: One idea: every angle is drawn the same way, with the base ray on the zero line and the count starting at that zero. Watch for students who read the scale that starts at the other zero and draw the wrong angle.

video_script.why: The child uses the steps for drawing an angle of thirty degrees on five new sizes, some narrower and some wider than a square corner.
video_script.substitution: The five sizes of the book's question: one hundred and ten, forty, seventy five, one hundred and twelve and one hundred and thirty four degrees.
video_script.anchor: the protractor of the book, laid over a base ray, with its centre point, its zero lines and its scales
video_script.payoff_line: Draw every angle the same way

final_answer.value: Draw every angle the same way: put the base ray on the 0 line, mark the point at the size needed, and join the mark to the vertex
final_answer.spoken: draw every angle the same way

hold_back: join the mark to the vertex
maths_rules: the centre of the protractor lies on the vertex, and the base ray lies along a zero line
count the degrees from that zero, on the scale that starts at zero on the base ray
the middle of each scale is 90 degrees, the size of a square corner
40 and 75 are narrower than a square corner; 110, 112 and 134 are wider
112 is 110 and two small marks more, and 134 is 130 and four small marks more
mark the point at the size needed and join it to the vertex with a ruler
video_script.design: The protractor stays on the board. The same four steps are shown once, and the five sizes are marked on the scale one after another, so the pupil sees that the steps never change.
open_questions: The book solution only says to draw each angle with a protractor, and gives no figures. The video shows the same steps for all five sizes and does not state any drawn figure.
